scores.note: Most faithful to the KB/registry/robots VERIFY rules: ingest after moderation, kb id without ml, 404/410 allow per the robots ruling, most-restrictive QarenBot/'*' verdict, currency evidence, DENY_HOSTS without touching SOURCE_REGISTRY. Defects: D06 seeds only the 368 JSON rows, but with ENABLE_BH_GCC_CATALOG_SOURCES OFF the registry is the 44 literals (source_router.py:474-481). D10 installs the SDK without the SR8 pin. Units cite D22 where D21 is meant and D18 where D17 is meant. The provider, quota, share and speed work is pushed to an unnamed lane that is not file-disjoint.

Closest to the VERIFY provider and legal rules. The router sits above guarded_llm_create. Routing is consent>=3. Ledger rows are recorded before raising. The pricing module is separate, so test_cost_meter_s74 EXACT_KEYS stays green (verified :440). There is a Riyadh Lua quota and a flip runbook. Defects: S81-15 deletes the :347 literal and reddens test_rating_tiers with no ON-only qualifier, and never lists the live fetchers. S81-06 omits 3 of the 6 files holding the 16 sites (image_service, url_extraction_service, verdict_critique_service). The hardcoded mini rates are not fixed. Share, speed, feedback and reviews are deferred.

Best on loop stalls, SSE pairing, client floors, share, Q1 feedback, remote-flagged chips and the 1.0.1 P0 strings. Missing: the llm ledger and the spend breaker (a VERIFY violation), and any plan to close OpenAI for pre-v3 clients. The plan also has no kb_gaps or kb_specs table, no operator capture, no web_search and no reviews channel. The guard fix sits only inside ingest, but the drop happens upstream (price_service.py:527-538). It proposes pre-approval canaries, and it has a zero-'OpenAI' pin that conflicts with the transition disclosure.
